bayts.text: Truly I address all the Christians, in their land, in need (only) of my Master:
be certain that I am, for Allah, a slave, and a servant of the Messenger of Allah,
and that I have never ceased to dissociate myself from whoever dares (persist) in disbelief,
and I do not flatter those who have become Christians, if He Who bestows discernment so wills.
Glory be to Him, the Lord in Whom I take refuge, and from Whom I hope for relief from distress.
How generous a Lord He is! He leads what He wills of wishes to whom He wills among creatures.
I have thanked Him and I bear witness that I thank Him, and with my heart and my tongue I remember Him.
I worship Him through His religion, Islam, affirming His oneness, with surrender.
And bear witness for me, all of you, to my word, on a Day that shall gather all the worlds.
Allah is my Lord, outwardly and inwardly, wherever I may be, travelling or settled,
and the Chosen One is my means of approach to Him: may the Exalted bless him, with peace.
O whole of creation, bear witness for me on the Day when the guilty shall receive blame,
that I am, in the two Abodes, the slave of Allah, the servant of His slave, the son of ʿAbd Allāh,
that I love every Muslim man and woman, and loathe every sinful man and woman.
I, Aḥmad, have written it, bearing blessing upon the Prophet of Allah, the bestower of gifts.
